mechanism: Chlorthalidone-induced hypokalemia and hyponatremia may potentiate ivermectin's neurotoxic effects and increase CNS adverse effects, particularly in patients with impaired renal function or high parasitic loads.
action: Monitor serum electrolytes (potassium and sodium) during concurrent use; consider electrolyte supplementation if needed; counsel patients on signs of neurotoxicity and ensure adequate hydration.
